description: Spec 037 research R2: bearing-error conditions whose kinds are never drawn in the fine-tuning mix (configs/regress/ft-mix.json) or in any tuning. ho-t3: the white error is Student-t with 3 degrees of freedom at the same sd. ho-step2: the error level doubles or halves from a time uniform in the engagement. ho-both: both; the registered held-out condition.
